h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kumbakonam

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kumbakonam

items.pText: Kumbakonam is a temple town in the Cauvery delta, and many of the institutions that run schools and community spaces here are trusts and religious bodies. They tend to buy carefully and expect equipment to last for many years in heat and seasonal floods. FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,160 km away, and sends it to Tamil Nadu by road.

Elsewhere in the state, we have installed a resort playground in Dindigul, and we supply schools, trusts, societies and parks across the region. Send us your site size, the age group and a few photos. We will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, and install through our team or a dealer once you approve.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: The delta is flat, and during the north-east monsoon from October to December water can stand on open ground for days. Do not place a playground in the lowest part of a compound. Raise the base slightly above the surrounding ground, slope it towards a drain and use rubber flooring, which dries far faster than soil.
for an example of our work in the state. For trusts and schools that want something with an Indian character, our
structures draw on traditional games, and the
collection is built around group play. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to temple trusts in Kumbakonam?
items.a: Yes. We supply trusts, schools, societies and parks. Share your site details and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing before you approve a quote.

items.q: How do we keep the play area usable in the rainy season?
items.a: Raise the base slightly, slope it towards a drain and lay rubber flooring. Avoid the lowest corner of the compound, where water collects first.

items.q: Do you have equipment based on Indian games?
items.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals range includes Timeless Play and Khel Khud, designed by our own team with many pieces inspired by Indian games and nature.
